text:
maria: Heads-up — ran through the new edge-lite Next starter (edge-lite-starter) onboarding and it stalls at the embedding step. Seems like the JS SDK auth/retry loop kicks in and never resolves. anyone else?

jake: I hit this earlier today. console shows repeated 401s then the SDK retries without backoff. looks like maxRetries isn't honored in v0.9.

sophia: Oof. Can you paste the snippet of the error?

jake: Sure — copy from terminal: 
```
[2024-10-03T15:22:01.123Z] ERROR embed-worker AuthError: 401 Unauthorized - token expired
    at fetchWithAuth (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/index.js:412:15)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
[2024-10-03T15:22:01.124Z] DEBUG retry Retrying request (attempt 1)
[2024-10-03T15:22:01.125Z] DEBUG retry Retrying request (attempt 2)
... repeats every 100ms
```

maria: In our starter the embed call is inside getServerSideProps for SSR auth demo. If the SDK sits retrying the request the page never renders.

kevin: Quick workaround: set REDWOOD_API_KEY in Vercel env or local .env and short-circuit the SDK client creation during SSR until we patch. Also run `npx redwood-login --refresh` to force a new token.

sophia: Another workaround: wrap the embed call with a per-request timeout + fallback: return a 202 response and queue background embed task. ugly but prevents blocking first render.

jake: I dug into the SDK: the retry loop uses a defaultRetryStrategy that ignores options.maxRetries when auth error === true. simple check missing. I'll open a small PR to add an exponential backoff + cap.

maria: Thanks — repro is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge-lite-repro (private org). branch is "maria/auth-retry-repro".

ci-bot: CI pipeline started for branch maria/auth-retry-repro — 1 job queued :gear:  

kevin: Jake — if you need a quick unit test, add a mock fetch that returns 401 twice then 200 and assert total wait >= backoff sum. happy to help.

jake: Will do. PR will target sdk-auth-fixes, include changelog and a small integration test for the Next starter. ETA EOD.

sophia: I'll run the starter against the eval harness after the PR — want to make sure embeddings latency and token accounting don't regress.

maria: awesome, thanks all. Leaving this pinned on the starter repo issues. :thumbsup:

jake: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 — small patch + test — assigning kevin for review.

maria: Verified locally with the patch — embedding step finishes and SSR page renders fallback content when token failure persists. marking as resolved on my end.

ci-bot: Build passed for sdk PR #412 on main (checks: unit, integration, e2e). :white_check_mark:
